BIOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
